info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Credit Rating Update API allows businesses to modify credit rating information for customers based on specific parameters. This endpoint supports PATCH requests, enabling adjustments to existing customer credit ratings using a unique identifier. Typically used by customer relationship management systems and financial institutions, this API facilitates timely updates to customer financial data, ensuring accurate assessment and risk management. It empowers businesses to respond swiftly to changes in customer status, thereby enhancing customer service and operational efficiency.

requestBody.description: Updates the credit rating information for a specific customer. Ensure that all required fields are provided and are in the correct format to successfully update the customer's credit rating.
